title: Disappointing...
text: Disappointing.... I love the idea of beeswax food storage wraps but unfortunately, for me, these turned out to be disappointing.  They're very sticky.  Due to the stickiness, they pick up every single crumb or speck of dirt/dust.  They must be washed frequently as well.  For the cost of these, they're just not worth it to me.  Too much hassle.  Perhaps if some improvements were made, I'd give them a try again but for now, I won't purchases these again.
